# AL1102: Mixed form collection and DTO

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/ANcpLua.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Severity | Error |
| Category | `ASP.NET Core` |

| Analyzer | `Al1100ToAl1104FormBindingAnalyzer` |
| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

Mixing IFormCollection with a [FromForm] DTO is not supported. Choose one approach: use IFormCollection for dynamic form access or a typed DTO for structured binding.
